parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility ban, border/document targeting, or organised police targeting is documented, and same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2021 after 15 years unenforced - avoiding tier-1/2 exposure. However, if outed, recourse is thin: police reportedly dismiss trans victims' complaints because resident ID carries a male marker, families pressure acceptance, and referrals are slow, producing documented impunity; healthcare discrimination is singled out. Social pattern is invisibility/stigma rather than documented acceptance, and the 4x assault multiplier lacks a verifiable survey basis so is not weighted as prevalence. Absence of resident LGR/anti-discrimination law is not itself deducted for a visitor. This is tier-3 hostility/discrimination with inadequate remedy, below acceptance-with-working-protection jurisdictions.
